summary.text: Heavenly Light Ring is a refinement path killer move. Seven rotations of the ring are required to refine rank seven heavenly secret Immortal Gu.

claims.text: In the Gu refinement hall, Fang Yuan takes over the final step after Sixth Hair dispels the refinement path Gu formation. Surrounding white light condenses into a circular shape, then takes material form. After a dozen breaths the hall’s light returns to normal. A white-gold ring the size of a house floats quietly with Fang Yuan at its center. Sixth Hair names the refinement path killer move Heavenly Light Ring internally, saying it has finally formed.

Fang Yuan wills the first rotation, which takes fifteen minutes. His gaze drives the second, faster, in seven minutes. His breath resonates with the ring for the third, finished in an instant. He hums for the fourth, and the ring spins violently until that rotation completes. After a rest he raises his arms as if carrying a heavy load. The ring rotates and also ascends. At his shoulder it pauses and explodes. Fang Yuan, at the center, takes the full force, spatters blood, and is heavily injured. The refinement of rank seven heavenly secret Immortal Gu fails.

Fang Yuan takes over again after Sixth Hair deactivates the hall formation. White light condenses into a huge ring parallel to the ground, surrounding him. The refinement path killer move Heavenly Light Ring activates. The first rotation succeeds by his will, the second by his gaze, the third by his breath. The fourth, fifth, and sixth also succeed. At the seventh the ring has already shrunk to basin-size and floats above his head. It shrinks into a tiny speck. Heavenly secret Gu at rank seven lands on Fang Yuan’s head.

Four Elements Square Regret Blood Refinement Pool can utilize this refinement path killer move among others, including slumbering lightning python, wind grind, reflect snow, muffled thunder stone drum, dragon-shaped blizzard, refinement snake lifespan flower, and omnipresent four seas.
